method: Continuous wall intervals 120/300 s; percentiles numpy linear. Every-frame timestamps; transform timings are game-thread observations, not scanout. Last-drawn-frame raw stat-unit CPU/GPU time; no GPU time inferred from cap. Buffered control removes per-frame log I/O, not JSON collection cost.

latencyExplanation.unchangedSmoothing: Exponential / NetworkSimulatedSmoothLocationTime=0.1s; at zero velocity time=0.05s
latencyExplanation.interpretation: Fully-settled mesh threshold includes physical braking and discrete exponential smoothing, not merely transport delay. At 30Hz factor is ~1/3, at 60Hz ~2/3. No engine or smoothing changes made.

selection.latencyFlagRule: Review if median increases >20ms or p95 >33ms versus A; not a gameplay rule
selection.stutterRule: Reject repeated 3x >100ms or an isolated >500ms; report every >100ms regardless
